name: Saksham Scheme for Backward Classes
benefit: 1. Under the scheme, loans of up to ₹10,00,000/- are provided to young professionals for setting up Doctors&#39; Clinics, Nursing Homes, Physiotherapy Clinics, Bio-Medical Labs, Lawyers&#39; Offices, Engineering Units, Chemist Shops, Architect Offices, etc.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Haryana.
   1. The applicant should be between 18 and 35 years old.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Backward Class Category.
   1. The applicant&#39;s annual family income should not exceed ₹3,00,000/- in both rural and urban areas.
   1. The applicant should have professional and academic training.
